dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid, non-gradient pixel clusters; light-toned features are primarily characterized by complex internal textures rather than uniform solid blobs.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli define an elongated, asymmetrical quadrilateral along the upper lateral flank.
